reading: Light always rides its own space at unit speed. The chart value of the cone is -beta +/- N and changes with radius because the recorded lapse and shift carry the room's stress; the ray frequency dilution 1/N(r) is how much the value of light has changed after riding the space. This is a reading of measured numbers on evaluated grids, not a law and not a cosmology claim.
